description: Route n=1024 B=60 onto the cooperative cluster panel — it is WORK-STARVED on the single-CTA path (only 60 matrices = 60 CTAs on 148 SMs), exactly like n=2048 B=8 was before brief 24 routed it to the cluster for a 1.26x shape win. The K-by-batch law: n=4096 B=2->K=16, n=2048 B=8->K=8, so n=1024 B=60 wants a SMALL K (2-4) — fewer CTAs/matrix, more matrices resident. Add n=1024 to the cluster-routed set with a swept small K; the cluster panel is FP32 Householder (stable all conditioning) and the trailing is TF32 (budget ~2.4e-3, safe). This is the same proven mechanism that won n=2048; n=1024 is 3 of 12 shapes (n=1024 dense/mixed/nearrank). Keep n=512/tiny-n/n=352/n=2048/n=4096 exactly as parent (b050aa33). NOTE: FP32 GEMM on B200 is SIMT not tensor-core, so the win here is OCCUPANCY/parallelism (filling idle SMs), not precision. Avoid the substring 'stream' incl. comments.

Trial 1: route n=1024 B=60 -> _blocked_qr_cluster (added 1024 to _CLUSTER_N), K=4, mhyb=256, uniform TF32 trailing, nb=32. Kept n=512/tiny-n/n=352/n=2048/n=4096 EXACTLY as parent. 22 tests + 3 guards CLEAN (n=1024 dense/mixed/nearrank/clustered all pass; diff_correctness 8 seeds clean). NO panel_set_max_smem hoist needed (single-CTA panel_factor only runs short trailing m<mhyb, cap small). METRIC = clean light-mode geomean min 8810us (n=512 anchor 17672). Back-to-back light-mode A/B vs parent (n=512 identical 17665/17672): n=1024 dense 20975->18981 (1.105x), mixed 23358->19059 (1.226x), nearrank 20929->19051 (1.099x); geomean 9098->8810 (1.033x). nsys n=1024: panel_factor_cluster_kernel 52.1%, single-CTA short-trailing panel<512> 28.4%, TF32 GEMMs 22%. Fleet bimodal: deep-slow reads were 12700us (n=512=26600), code-independent contention. NOTE the 28% single-CTA chunk hinted the cluster wasn't the win.

Trial 2: K-by-batch sweep + mhyb sweep. K {2,3,4,5,6} light-mode A/B (n=512 anchor ~17670): n=1024 dense K2=19649/K4=18981/K5=19229/K6=19268 -> clear U-optimum at K=4 (highest batch). Then mhyb {128,256,384,512,768,1024} back-to-back at K=4 (light): n=1024 dense mhyb128=19328/256=18981/512=18425/768=17995/1024=15009 -> MONOTONIC, higher mhyb is faster. The cooperative cluster panel HURTS n=1024 B=60 (unlike work-starved n=2048 B=8/n=4096 B=2): B=60 already gives decent single-CTA occupancy, so the real win is single-CTA panel at threads=512 + uniform TF32 (skips parent _routed_qr classify+reorder on mixed). mhyb=1024 keeps ONLY the j=0 panel on cluster. METRIC = clean light-mode geomean 8298us. A/B vs parent (light, n=512 identical): n=1024 dense 20975->15009 (1.397x), mixed 23358->15007 (1.557x), nearrank 20929->15006 (1.395x); geomean 9098->8298 (1.096x). 22 tests + 3 guards CLEAN. Single-CTA SMEM at m=1024 ~139KB < 228KB B200 cap.

Trial 3 (BEST): mhyb=1025 -> n=1024 runs FULLY single-CTA panel(threads=512)+uniform TF32, cluster kernel NEVER fires (still dispatched through _blocked_qr_cluster; mhyb>n). Back-to-back deep-mode A/B vs mhyb=1024 (n=512 anchor identical ~26600): no-cluster n=1024 dense 21345 vs j=0-cluster 21693, mixed 21324 vs 21696, nearrank 21393 vs 21697 -- even the single j=0 cluster panel is a ~1.5% net NEGATIVE. METRIC = clean light-mode geomean min 8291us (8291/8298 two light runs). DEFINITIVE light-mode A/B vs parent (n=512 anchor identical 17671/17672): n=1024 dense 20969->15126 (1.386x), mixed 22323->14807 (1.508x), nearrank 20998->14852 (1.414x); geomean 9064->8291 (1.093x). 22 tests + 3 guards CLEAN. nsys n=1024: panel_factor_cluster_kernel GONE; single-CTA panel<512> now 85.0%, TF32 GEMMs 14% -> the single-CTA panel is the new n=1024 wall. Kept n=512/tiny-n/n=352/n=2048/n=4096 EXACTLY as parent (those ratios ~1.000 in every A/B).

DONE (3 trials, HEAD=4fb45eec). Routed n=1024 B=60 through _blocked_qr_cluster as the brief asked, swept K {2,3,4,5,6} and mhyb {128,256,384,512,768,1024,1025}. KEY FINDING (contradicts the cluster hypothesis, measured not assumed): the cooperative cluster panel is a NET NEGATIVE at n=1024 B=60. The mhyb sweep at K=4 is MONOTONIC -- the higher the crossover the faster (n=1024 dense light-mode: mhyb128=19328/256=18981/512=18425/768=17995/1024=15009us) -- and a clean back-to-back deep-mode A/B shows even the single j=0 cluster panel costs ~1.5% (no-cluster mhyb=1025 21345 vs j=0-cluster mhyb=1024 21693us). Unlike the work-starved n=2048 B=8 / n=4096 B=2 the cluster wins on, B=60 already gives the single-CTA panel decent occupancy, so the per-column cluster.sync overhead doesn't pay. The ACTUAL win is two orthogonal levers the cluster path carries: (a) the single-CTA panel_factor run at threads=512 (parent's _routed_qr ran n=1024 at threads=128), and (b) UNIFORM TF32 trailing (skips the parent's per-matrix classify + argsort + gather/inverse-permute that _routed_qr paid on the heterogeneous mixed batch -- that's why mixed gets the biggest win). BEST = trial 3 (mhyb=1025, K=4): n=1024 runs FULLY single-CTA threads=512 + uniform TF32, cluster kernel never fires. DEFINITIVE clean light-mode A/B vs parent (n=512 anchor identical 17671/17672us, so apples-to-apples): n=1024 dense 20969->15126 (1.386x), mixed 22323->14807 (1.508x), nearrank 20998->14852 (1.414x); whole-benchmark geomean 9064->8291us = 1.093x. Win is robust across both contention modes (normalized n=1024/n512 ratio ~0.80 mine vs ~1.19-1.33 parent). 22 tests + 3 guards CLEAN every trial (n=1024 dense/mixed/nearrank/clustered pass uniform TF32 with margin; factor scaled-resid 1.2-6.9 << gate 20). K-sweep: clear U-optimum at K=4 (but moot since the cluster is off at the optimum). Kept n=512/tiny-n/n=352/n=2048/n=4096 EXACTLY as parent (every A/B shows those shapes ratio ~1.000). nsys trial-3 n=1024: cluster kernel GONE, single-CTA panel<512> now 85.0% (the NEW wall), TF32 GEMMs 14%. Fleet was bimodal all run (deep-slow ~12700/light ~8300, code-independent); I used immediate back-to-back A/B + the n=512 anchor to cut through it. OPEN DIRECTIONS the manager may pursue: (1) the single-CTA panel_factor<512> is now 85% of n=1024 and ncu-unprofiled here -- a macro brief that widens it (>512 threads needs a new launch_bounds template; or a 2-level/cluster-INSIDE-panel variant tuned for B=60) is the next n=1024 wall; (2) my finding that uniform-TF32-without-reorder beats _routed_qr's classify+reorder at n=1024 SHOULD be re-tested at n=512 B=640 -- if the reorder overhead also exceeds its TF32 win there, routing n=512's mixed/dense through a uniform-TF32 _blocked_qr (no classify) could be a separate win on 4 of 12 shapes (but n=512 band/rowscale need FP32, so only the all-well + a cheap whole-batch-TF32-safe check); (3) the threads=512 single-CTA panel was not itself swept for n=1024 (only 128 vs 512 exist) -- an intermediate or a per-n nb!=32 might shave the 85% panel; (4) trial-3 still ROUTES n=1024 through _blocked_qr_cluster with mhyb>n (cluster never fires) -- a simplify brief could express this as a direct single-CTA+uniform-TF32 path and drop the dead cluster routing for n=1024. KEEP GOING -- the single-CTA panel is the next thing to break at n=1024.
